newsitem.title: EGYPT: Medinet Nasr Housing offering free share.
newsitem.headline: Medinet Nasr Housing offering free share.

text.p: Shares in Medinet Nasr Housing and Development jumped more than 25 percent on Wednesday on an announcement that the board was offering one free share for every share issued, switching 20 million pounds ($5.9 million) from reserves to capital.

The company, one of the most successful privatisations of the year, has already announced a dividend of 10.00 pounds for each of the four million shares for the financial year 1995/6, which ended on June 30.

The announcement on Wednesday took the market by surprise despite some rumours earlier this month. At 3.30 p.m. (1330) GMT, shares on the Egyptian stock exchange were trading at 240.00 pounds from 190.00 at the close on Tuesday. The share issue will increase the paid-in capital to 40 million pounds from 20 million. The shares have a nominal value of five pounds each.
The company made net distributable profits of 52.21 million pounds in 1995/6, 43 percent up on 36.53 million in 1994/5. It ended the year with reserves of 37.583 million pounds.
The board called a shareholders meeting for December 10 to discuss its free share proposal.
